title: Zamparini's wheat field where a spaceship landed

tellings.quote: me a field. He had this wheat field, you see, where a spaceship had landed on several occasions.

plain: An Italian man named Maurizio Zamparini had a wheat field where a spaceship landed several times in the late 1990s, and he showed the field to Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a republic inside Russia. Xenov repeats what Zamparini told him and showed him, and says there were golden plates with imprints of the landings and photographs taken by scientists, which would be physical traces of the visits if true.
